name: Tam
description: Tam is a gorgon Quandrix student at Strixhaven who was created from Jace's blood and marrow to inherit his spark.

summary.text: Tam is a gorgon Quandrix student at Strixhaven who was created from Jace's blood and marrow to inherit his spark.

bio.text: As a student she joined Lluwen's trip to Titan's Grave and later pushed the oracle Jadzi into the nexus before jumping in herself, saying she was made to do this.
She turned out to be an artificial being made by the Theorist, who taught her and sent her on missions, and she kidnapped Jadzi and regretted it.
Sent to measure Innistrad, she was sheltered by Moiren and caught in a psychic prison by the monster in the moon, before she escaped.
After learning what the overwrite would do, she resolved to stop her maker, allied with Vraska, and freed Liliana from her cell.
She reunited with Kirol, then called Emrakul to devour the Echoverse, and received Jace's spark as his fail-safe, becoming complete.
She introduced herself to Kirol as Just Tam, sent her friends home, and planeswalked to Strixhaven, arriving at Ranna's door to say she was there to make things better.

status.text: As of the latest story Tam is a complete, real person who holds Jace's spark and has planeswalked home to Strixhaven.

timeline.summary: Sanar writes a twenty-six page letter about Spectacle Summit; Tam asks everyone to keep letters to a page or two.
timeline.quote: Can we please keep letters to a page or two?

timeline.summary: Tam recounts meeting Fel at night and decides he is worth working with; she offers to accompany Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Lluwen, if it would help you to have company, I don't mind coming along at all.

timeline.summary: Lluwen and Tam arrive at Jawdocks Landing in Titan's Grave, where Jadzi and Fel greet the students.
timeline.quote: Oracle Jadzi was the one who greeted all of us when we arrived at Jawdocks Landing.

timeline.summary: Tam and Lluwen talk for hours with Jadzi until Fel scolds them for wasting the oracle's time.
timeline.quote: We spent a few hours talking, just the three of us

timeline.summary: Tam consoles Lluwen and tells him of a frightening encounter with the same spirit, who threw a spear at her group.
timeline.quote: He hurled a spectral spear at me.

timeline.summary: Tam tells Lluwen that archaics were once oracles and suggests speaking with Jadzi.
timeline.quote: she told me that all archaics used to be oracles.

timeline.summary: Lluwen admits to Tam that he did not tell Jadzi about the archaics; Tam hugs him.
timeline.quote: You aren't a coward.

timeline.summary: The ground shakes and a massive creature wreathed in star arches looms over the camp, and Tam freezes.
timeline.quote: A massive figure blocked the gold of the moon.

timeline.summary: The giant creature stands and walks away, leaving the camp in chaos.
timeline.quote: it walked away.

timeline.summary: Fel asks Tam and Lluwen if they have seen Oracle Jadzi, who is missing.
timeline.quote: His eyes burning, Fel asked the two of them if they had seen Oracle Jadzi.

timeline.summary: Tam wakes beneath the earth after the archaic's attack; Kirol is hurling boughs off trapped students and Sanar and Abigale are helping.
timeline.quote: That bulky frame hurling boughs off the trapped students could only be Kirol.

timeline.summary: Lluwen tells Tam they are in Titan's Grave, deeper than any records go.
timeline.quote: "In Titan's Grave. Deeper than we have any records of going, if we can trust the Shattered."

timeline.summary: Tam asks Suki to join the group, and the Shattered come over to share what they know.
timeline.quote: "Come join us," said Tam.

timeline.summary: Back at camp Tam frets over being left behind while Sanar and Suki build a metronome clock.
timeline.quote: Sanar and Suki were working on a metronome-based clock.

timeline.summary: Fetching water, Tam sees a man in white in the reflection until Lluwen's shout breaks the moment.
timeline.quote: It was a man in white.

timeline.summary: A strange feeling of dread spreads through the group and tempers flare; Lluwen snaps at Tam and Kirol.
timeline.quote: "You're the one who brought up the tension.

timeline.summary: The tunnel turns against the students and roots seize Lluwen, threatening to drag him into the earth while his friends pull him back.
timeline.quote: Vines wrapped around Lluwen's ankles and threatened to pull him into the earth.

timeline.summary: Fel says he has been trying to find a way to keep an old promise, and Tam reveals she knows he sought to save the woman he loved, from Jadzi.
timeline.quote: You wanted to try and find some way to go back and save the woman you loved."

timeline.summary: Tam leads the group's friends into the caverns, and Sanar smells burning.
timeline.quote: "Does anyone else smell burning?"

timeline.summary: Suki calls out that her teacher is in trouble and runs ahead, with Tam following.
timeline.quote: "Shatter Prime's in trouble."

timeline.summary: The students feel reality tremble as they run toward the fight.
timeline.quote: Reality was a rippling tapestry being torn apart and rewoven right before their eyes.

timeline.summary: The group is thrown through shifting environments as reality ripples around the archaic.
timeline.quote: Kirol spit up sea water.

timeline.summary: The students arrive to find Chandra and Ajani injured and leaning on one another.
timeline.quote: Next to her—with her arm slung across his shoulders like a wounded soldier—was Ajani Goldmane.

timeline.summary: Tam pushes Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.
timeline.quote: She pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.

timeline.summary: Tam tells her friends that she was made to do this and that they made her happy, then steps into the pit.
timeline.quote: "I was made to do this."

timeline.summary: The nexus snaps shut after Tam jumps in, leaving the friends shocked.
timeline.quote: Lluwen stared at the not-snarl as it snapped shut.

timeline.summary: In a place that is not quite Strixhaven, Tam stands over the sleeping Jadzi and is comforted by a man in white, who promises she will meet others like her.
timeline.quote: "You've found the others?" she asked him.

timeline.summary: Tam is made and wakes to find an exhausted man who tells her that her name is Tamira but who she is is up to her.
timeline.quote: "Your name is Tamira, but who you are is up to you."

timeline.summary: He tells her she is a person in progress.
timeline.quote: "In progress. Yeah. You're a person in progress."

timeline.summary: Tam returns to Hexhaven after kidnapping Jadzi from Strixhaven, feeling empty rather than victorious.
timeline.quote: On paper, she returned from Strixhaven victorious, her mission complete, her captured oracle in hand.

timeline.summary: Tam sees a vision of Abigale accusing her of lying and leaving.
timeline.quote: You left , signs Abigale. You lied, and you left.

timeline.summary: Tam sees a vision of Lluwen telling her she is just parts.
timeline.quote: "You're just parts ."

timeline.summary: Tam asks Professor Opal about friendship, and Opal tells her not to feel guilty for acts of service to her maker.
timeline.quote: Do not feel guilty for acts of service.

timeline.summary: Tam bursts into the sanctum to find the Theorist fighting a masked boy, who wounds him; the Theorist hurls the boy through a portal.
timeline.quote: the Theorist summons a portal—a great round one, rimmed with metal—and hurls the boy into it.

timeline.summary: The Theorist explains that excising aberrations stabilizes the Multiverse spell, and that now he is wholly one thing.
timeline.quote: "Yes. Now that I am wholly one thing, I know exactly who I am."

timeline.summary: The Theorist reveals he plans to overwrite the existing Multiverse by laying the Echoverse over it.
timeline.quote: "Correct. We need to overwrite the existing Multiverse to make this one stable."

timeline.summary: He reveals that Jadzi must die so he can follow her consciousness back to the origin of a Multiverse.
timeline.quote: "Oh, yes. It's the only way for the phenomenon to be observed.

timeline.summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind and reassures her, and she finds a textbook with Jace Beleren's name in it.
timeline.quote: JACE BELEREN is scrawled in a child's hand in the upper-left corner.

timeline.summary: Tam visits Jadzi's cell and apologizes, and Jadzi tells her she will find what she is looking for.
timeline.quote: "You'll get what you're looking for."

timeline.summary: Vess, imprisoned in a hexed cell, taunts Tam about betraying her friends and knowing where Jace puts his shame.
timeline.quote: "I know you, Beleren! I know where you put your shame!"

timeline.summary: Flashback: Tam found the Theorist's earlier self lost in a vision of Phyrexia's attack on Vryn.
timeline.quote: She knows without doubt that this was Vryn under Phyrexian attack

timeline.summary: Flashback: the Theorist carves the first aberration out of his mind and kicks it through a portal.
timeline.quote: Tam's maker suddenly ripped open a portal and kicked him through with full force.

timeline.summary: Tam telepathically tells the Theorist that he used her to bring Jadzi to her death, and he admits he carved away the part that knew why he made her.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure. I carved the one that knew away.

timeline.summary: Tam climbs to the roof in the night, doubts herself, and reminds herself she is in progress.
timeline.quote: I'm in progress , she reminds herself.

timeline.summary: Tam, lonely in her hexed dormitory, writes a letter of apology and warning to Abigale and burns it.
timeline.quote: The letter ignites quickly, quietly, and burns easily in the waste bin.

timeline.summary: Tam visits Liliana, who asks if Jace is her father or boyfriend, and Tam takes her to see the orrery.
timeline.quote: Tam unlocks the bars, walks to the wood and stone sphere, and holds up a hand.

timeline.summary: Tam shows Liliana the orrery copy and asks what overwriting will mean; Liliana explains it will suffocate the original Multiverse.
timeline.quote: "It won't tear them apart, but layering one Multiverse on another will smother the souls of everyone in the original.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Tam that she has the best parts of Jace and asks her to tell Jace not to keep a woman in a dungeon.
timeline.quote: "From what I can tell, the best parts of himself."

timeline.summary: Tam passes Chandra in the tower and sees Lluwen's vision resentfully remark about half people.
timeline.quote: Why do these half people get to win when the real ones have to die?"

timeline.summary: Tam confronts the Theorist with her feelings; he silences her with a command and then hugs her.
timeline.quote: The Theorist flinches, lip curling like he slugged back a bitter liquor.

timeline.summary: The Theorist tells Tam to purge herself of doubt as he does.
timeline.quote: "Then purge yourself of doubt," he says

timeline.summary: The Theorist sends Tam to Innistrad through an Omenpath to record its planar data.
timeline.quote: "Go to Innistrad. I need its planar dimensions, including extraplanetary bodies.

timeline.summary: Tam measures Innistrad's dimensions and discovers she can briefly freeze a rat with her gaze without petrifying it.
timeline.quote: The rat does not move, but does not turn to stone.

timeline.summary: Tam reaches an inn and learns from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town.
timeline.quote: "My uncle died the day the town became the Town.

timeline.summary: Tam has her first beer, and Moiren tells her that suffering is the only constant and the church teaches death is rest.
timeline.quote: "The church teaches that death is the rest we are rewarded in the end.

timeline.summary: Three vampires attack the inn; Moiren fights them and Tam freezes them with her gaze so Moiren can behead them.
timeline.quote: Tam stares , and all three vampires freeze in place.

timeline.summary: Moiren tells Tam she is worth saving.
timeline.quote: "You're worth saving, Miss Tam."

timeline.summary: At night Tam reaches out telepathically, and the monster in the moon yanks her mind into a psychic prison.
timeline.quote: Something hears her and yanks her up.

timeline.summary: The monster speaks through an emaciated puppet woman, saying it eats time and hungers for her knowledge.
timeline.quote: I have eaten time , says the woman

timeline.summary: Tam braids the puppet's hair to appease it, and learns it eats planes.
timeline.quote: "You eat planes."

timeline.summary: The monster demands to be shown where Tam's Multiverse is and offers to rid her of it; Tam escapes.
timeline.quote: Run! Tam can't help the scream she lets out

timeline.summary: Jace creates a pocket plane and uses a mirror spell to make a person, Tam, from a wisp of himself.
timeline.quote: A person, or rather a person-shaped miasma of blue, emerges.

timeline.summary: The Theorist cannot remember why he made Tam, saying only that she is important and must be protected, and wipes their memories again.
timeline.quote: I made a person, but this part of me does not remember why. She must be protected.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Tam in a hallway and recognizes who she is.
timeline.quote: "Vraska," she says. "I know your name."

timeline.summary: Tam warns Vraska that the Theorist can only be beaten by a telepath and says the tower is made of his memories; she tells her to rescue Jadzi.
timeline.quote: "It isn't worth it to fight him directly. You need to rescue Jadzi before he can use her."

timeline.summary: Tam heals the injured allies, restoring Garruk's muscles and Ajani's speech.
timeline.quote: Her eyes light up with blue, and after a long minute, both Chandra and Garruk relax.

timeline.summary: Tam goes to the Theorist and asks where the Echoverse versions of her friends are; he says they were skipped or removed.
timeline.quote: "They're not here. The process of creation is autonomous. Some things are likely to be skipped. Or removed. It's bound to happen."

timeline.summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind, learns she met Emrakul, and says Emrakul will be eliminated by the overwrite; Tam pushes back angrily.
timeline.quote: But he saw enough. "You spoke to Emrakul."

timeline.summary: The Theorist commands Tam to stop, but she counters his command and says she will no longer help.
timeline.quote: "This experiment has gone too far," she announces. "I won't help you anymore!"

timeline.summary: The Theorist releases another aberration, the Nihilist, who tells Tam she cannot win.
timeline.quote: A thud. Lungs drawing air. A second man lies on the floor.

timeline.summary: The Nihilist says the experiment is tearing the original Multiverse and that their death will mean nothing; he tells Tam to ask for help, and the Theorist kicks him through a portal.
timeline.quote: "Aberration!" snarls the Theorist, and a half-second later he flashes a portal into existence and kicks the Nihilist through it.

timeline.summary: Tam resolves to help stop her maker.
timeline.quote: Her mentor must be stopped, and she must aid in his downfall.

timeline.summary: In her dormitory, Tam reflects on what she wants and resolves to betray the worst part of her maker in honor of the best parts.
timeline.quote: I have to betray the worst part of him in honor of the best parts.

timeline.summary: Tam tricks Professor Opal into leaving the guard post and tosses a chicken package into Liliana's cell, which undoes the master hex.
timeline.quote: A violet flash in Liliana's cell provides the answer.

timeline.summary: Rats burst the bars and Liliana emerges free, eating the chicken wing.
timeline.quote: The weight of the rats bursts open the bars, and Liliana emerges, hands glowing violet

timeline.summary: Liliana strangles Professor Opal, her double, then threatens Tam before relenting.
timeline.quote: Liliana storms toward her double, pushes through the protective barrier, wraps her hands around Opal's throat, driving her back.

timeline.summary: Tam tells Liliana that Jace's body needs to die and asks her to stop him from a distance before he kills Jadzi.
timeline.quote: "I'm asking you to stop him before he can kill Jadzi and make everything worse."

timeline.summary: Liliana raises Professor Opal as a lich and says she will try to talk Jace down.
timeline.quote: "A lich," corrects Liliana, speaking through the mouth of Professor Opal.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him she loves all of him, and he recites a Vrynian prayer of betrothal, asking her to be there for Tam.
timeline.quote: Encircle our union and bind our futures, pleasant and painful, spouse to spouse, marriage to death."

timeline.summary: Tam runs from the tower as Hexhaven merges into Strixhaven, believing Jadzi is dead.
timeline.quote: She's too late. Jadzi must be dead.

timeline.summary: Hexhaven doppelgangers attack new Strixhaven students while Dellian Fel calmly conjures plants.
timeline.quote: The blank-eyed doppelgängers of Hexhaven flock to these new students

timeline.summary: Tam realizes the Theorist taught her everything except how to separate the planes once combined, and tries to push against the Echoverse's seam.
timeline.quote: He knows how two planes combined … but not how to separate them once the process begins.

timeline.summary: Tam hears Kirol, uses chance magic to deflect falling cobblestones, and saves them.
timeline.quote: and pulls at the threads of chance that crisscross high above.

timeline.summary: Kirol and Tam reunite in a hug; Tam apologizes and explains the overlay.
timeline.quote: Kirol lurches forward, shoving past the throngs of people between them, and envelops Tam in a hug.

timeline.summary: Tam explains her teacher's theorem cannot be reversed while part of him lives; Kirol tells her she will solve it and leaves to find their friends.
timeline.quote: "You're going to solve it," they say with certainty.

timeline.summary: Tam feels small and incomplete as the overlay spreads across the Multiverse and she is swallowed by the crowd.
timeline.quote: In this moment, Tam feels that she is inadequacy.

timeline.summary: The spark falls like a meteor and strikes Tam in the chest, filling her with energy and emotion.
timeline.quote: It hits her in the chest, and she gasps.

timeline.summary: Tam reaches out with her mind to Emrakul and asks her to feast on the false Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Will you feast at my invitation?

timeline.summary: Emrakul agrees, promising to devour and to heal.
timeline.quote: I will come to devour and to heal.

timeline.summary: Tam feels new dreams and wants from the spark and realizes the Echoverse is crashing into the original.
timeline.quote: She wants to learn how to ride a horse .

timeline.summary: Emrakul engulfs the sky over Hexhaven.
timeline.quote: Emrakul engulfs the sky.

timeline.summary: Emrakul opens her mouth and begins devouring the Echoverse, and doubles of planes fade.
timeline.quote: As the mirrored plane shakes and sputters, it begins to fade.

timeline.summary: Tam finds Kirol, Sanar, Abigale and Lluwen at the Folioplex and apologizes for what happened to Jadzi and to them.
timeline.quote: What happened to Jadzi is my responsibility.

timeline.summary: Tam chooses a name, introducing herself to Kirol as Just Tam.
timeline.quote: "I'm Tam. Just Tam."

timeline.summary: Tam directs her friends to the mage-ring and sends them home to Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: "Mage-ring at the back of the Folioplex," she replies

timeline.summary: Founder Sphinxes and cadets fight Emrakul as she distinguishes one plane from another and pulls matter into her maw.
timeline.quote: "She is distinguishing one plane from the other!"

timeline.summary: Hexhaven is marked as separate from Strixhaven and begins being drawn into the sky.
timeline.quote: Around her, Hexhaven is marked separate from Strixhaven.

timeline.summary: Jace's voice speaks in Tam's mind, telling her she is his fail-safe and she inherits his spark.
timeline.quote: I made you so you could inherit mine.

timeline.summary: Tam is complete, becoming real for the first time and recognizing herself as a clean slate.
timeline.quote: For the first time in her existence, she knows exactly who she is.

timeline.summary: Tam's eyes alight with blue and she planeswalks home to Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Tam's eyes alight with blue.

timeline.summary: Tam arrives at Ranna's door, introduces herself to Vraska and says she is here to help make things better; Ranna drops her teacups on seeing Tam.
timeline.quote: "I'm here to help make things better."

relations.note: Tam accompanies Lluwen to Titan's Grave.
relations.quote: if it would help you to have company, I don't mind coming along at all.

relations.note: She shares his tent to keep him company and hugs him.
relations.quote: But Tam had wanted to keep her friend company

relations.note: Tam pushes Jadzi into the nexus.
relations.quote: She pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.

relations.note: Tam is a second-year Quandrix student.
relations.quote: Tam is a second-year student in Quandrix

relations.note: The Theorist made Tam as an artificial being.
relations.quote: I'm a mage who made you for an incredibly special purpose

relations.note: He teaches Tam praestigial theory and telepathy.
relations.quote: The Theorist is a wonderful teacher.

relations.note: Tam carries out missions for her maker.
relations.quote: Your duty is to your maker.

relations.note: Tam kidnapped Jadzi and holds her captive, to her regret.
relations.quote: who was brought here to die

relations.note: Jace created Tam as a person with his chin, stance and talents.
relations.quote: so much of her is just him

relations.note: He calls her Tamira and teaches her.
relations.quote: We are scientists , Tamira.

relations.note: Tam remembers her as her cryomancer mentor.
relations.quote: her cryomancer mentor always took the time to explain how and why something was the way it was

relations.note: Moiren shelters Tam and fights beside her.
relations.quote: Her gifts come in many forms.

relations.note: Jace made Tam through a mirror spell in a pocket plane.
relations.quote: He pulls it out of the mirror, gasping with effort

relations.note: Tam warns and helps Vraska against her maker.
relations.quote: Then she is an ally.

relations.note: Tam resolves to stop and betray the worst part of her maker.
relations.quote: "I won't help you anymore!"

relations.note: Liliana says every part of Tam is Jace, made from his blood and marrow.
relations.quote: "You have his blood. You have his marrow. Every part of you is him."

relations.note: The Theorist taught Tam everything he knew.
relations.quote: The Theorist taught her everything he knew

relations.note: Kirol calls her a friend despite distrust.
relations.quote: "I don't trust you in the slightest, but I don't want you dead."

relations.note: Jace made Tam to inherit his spark.
relations.quote: I made you so you could inherit mine.

relations.note: Emrakul responds to Tam's invitation and later says you're welcome.
relations.quote: The electrons around her quiver. You're welcome.

pages_say.description: A studious gorgon Strixhaven student who wields paradox magic.
A gorgon Quandrix student from Shandalar who joins Lluwen on the Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave.
A gorgon Quandrix student who shares a tent with Lluwen and freezes before a giant archaic.
A gorgon student held in the Shattered camp, who later fights vines to restrain Chandra.
A Quandrix student at Strixhaven whose hair levitates and writhes when she is stirred up; she is trapped with her friends deep in Titan's Grave and keeps seeing a man in white in reflections.
A Quandrix student who, in the climax, pushes Jadzi into the nexus and jumps in herself, saying she was made to do this.
A gorgon second-year Quandrix student who uses paradox magic to rewrite probability.
An artificial telepath and gorgon made by the Theorist's earlier self, who kidnapped Jadzi from Strixhaven and is haunted by guilt and visions of her friends.
An artificial gorgon made by the Theorist who is torn between her duty and her real friends, and who tries to learn what overwriting the Multiverse will mean.
An artificial gorgon sent to measure Innistrad, who tests a new petrifying-like gaze, befriends an innkeeper and is trapped in a psychic vision by the monster in the moon.
An artificial gorgon made by Jace, who secretly helps Vraska and heals the others.
An artificial gorgon who, after talking to the Theorist, resolves to stop him and finds she can counter his commands.
A woman in her early twenties made from Jace's blood and marrow, who frees Liliana from her cell to stop the Theorist.
A person whom the Survivor asks Vraska to be there for.
A student apprentice taught by the Theorist who runs through the overlay and reunites with her friend Kirol, believing it is her job to stop the overlay.
A being made by Jace to inherit his spark; she calls Emrakul to devour the Echoverse, gains his spark and memories, and planeswalks home as a real person.
